# Contributing

Thank you for your interest in this website.

This repository is a **personal, read-only publication**: issues and pull requests are disabled, and outside contributions are not accepted. It is the source of a personal site and is maintained by its author only.

## What you can do

- **Reuse the code.** HTML structure, CSS, JavaScript, nginx configuration and scripts are available under the [MIT License](../LICENSE). The personal content (text, photo and logo) is not; see [Licenses](../README.md#11-licenses).
- **Report a security problem** privately, as described in the [security policy](SECURITY.md).
- **Get in touch** about anything else through the contact details on [gfilho.net](https://gfilho.net/).

## Conduct

Every interaction related to this project is covered by the [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
